Noelle (Partnerships): 72h sprint: marketplace go-live choreography. Call out red flags now.
Devon (Product): Listing copy + SKUs done. Need hero lock and partner quote.
Hana (Marketing): Hero ready for EN, mobile crop ready. FR/JP next day. Can we launch EN-first?
Noelle (Partnerships): OK if layout stays identical. Legal signoff on logos?
Legal (Counsel): Partner logos approved except for OmniChip  needs signed brand addendum by EOD tomorrow.
Olga (Partner): OmniChip will send addendum today. Also request their logo sits on the secondary hero variant.
Arjun (Engineering): SI smoke tests pass. One flaky tenant create in eu-west-1 under high load; adding client retry.
Felix (Platform): I'll add a soft concurrency cap for onboarding to protect Dedicated pools and set fallback to hosted-basic at 85% capacity.
Devon (Product): Who owns partner landing copy + integration notes? I'll draft copy if Arjun provides a short snippet.
Arjun (Engineering): Snippet below: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/tenants -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"name":"partner-tenant","region":"eu-west-1"}'
```
Hana (Marketing): Embargo set 11:00 BST Tue. Blog + press + partner email publish together. Queue social 30m pre.
BrandBot: Reminder: brand assets checklist: logos, clearspace, alt text. Link: https://assets.redwood/brand/marketplace
Legal (Counsel): Approve privacy blurb: "Usage data processed per Redwood and Partner terms." Partner ack required.
Olga (Partner): OmniChip acked privacy blurb. Addendum will land before EOD.
Felix (Platform): Preflight scheduled 05:30 BST tomorrow. I'll validate redirect chain, CDN purge, concurrency cap, and fallback.
Noelle (Partnerships): Assets matrix: hero (Hana), logos (Partners + Legal), snippet (Arjun), listing screenshots (Devon), throttle/runbook (Felix). If preflight green we meet Mon 09:00 BST for go/no-go. Keep this thread for blockers only. :rocket:
